description: Osimertinib is recommended, within its marketing authorisation, as an option for the adjuvant treatment of stage 1b to 3a non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) after complete tumour resection. It is for adults whose tumours have epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) exon 19 deletions or EGFR exon 21 (L858R) substitution mutations. It is only recommended if: • osimertinib is stopped at 3 years, or earlier if there is disease recurrence or unacceptable toxicity and • the company provides it according to the commercial arrangement.
